title: Third Citrix NetScaler zero-day in 10 days: CVE-2026-88779 hits SAML parser with CVSS 8.7. CISA orders federal agencies to patch by Oct. 7.
content_md:
Third Citrix NetScaler zero-day in 10 days: CVE-2026-88779 hits SAML parser with CVSS 8.7. CISA orders federal agencies to patch by Oct. 7. 

via Mastodon https://deafnews.it/en/article/citrix-netscaler-third-zero-day-in-10-days-cisa-sets-oct-7-deadline

CVE-2026-88779.evidence: Reported as the third NetScaler zero-day in 10 days with CISA ordering federal agencies to patch by Oct 7, consistent with exploitation before a patch existed.
